newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: PRESS DIGEST - IRELAND - AUGUST 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IRELAND - AUGUST 8.

text.p: Following are the highlights of the Irish press on Friday:

- Sonia O'Sullivan fails to qualify for 5,000 metres - Des Hanafin and Avril Doyle win seats in Seanad elections - Inflation figures show 1.2 percent increase in cost of living - Retail prices fell last month bringing inflation one to 1.2 percent over the past 11 months
- Microsoft may take on more Irish graduates
- Irish pound gain rules out immediate revaluation
- Alcopops on the rocks agian as drinks dispute fizzes up
- BSE blow: State research herd to be destroyed because of outbreak of mad cow disease
- Inflation down as price of clothing tumbles
- Private cash to fund 400 jail cells
- Man died after power cut hit life-saving unit
- Only 50 percent of larger firms invest in R & D
- Survey shows major shift in companies' attitude to marketing
- INPC sees its profits rise 4.0 percent as mandatory regime changes THE EXAMINER
- Foreign affairs minister Ray Burke warned his critics to back off or he would sue in relation to allegations that he had received back handers from building firms eight years ago
